samples.question: The image is a field of grey noise made of a dense cell lattice. Each 2x2 block of cells is electrically balanced so the raw field averages to uniform grey. Deinterlace it by keeping only the even-even cells (the top-left cell of every 2x2 block) and averaging within each kept cell. A solid triangle is then revealed. Which glyph is revealed, the upward-pointing triangle A or the downward-pointing triangle B? Answer A or B.
